items.title: Restore Bucket A dev-memory code paths only
items.context: Use path-limited restore from the pinned stash object for packages/main/src/core/dev-memory.ts and packages/main/src/handlers/dev-memory.ts only. Do not restore .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, .gitignore, runtime registry, smoke files, planner, NAV, or Layer4 docs.

items.title: Add focused dev-memory legacy-read verification
items.context: Add a narrow smoke test proving .lattice entries are preferred/written, .koala entries are read-only fallback, duplicate ids are deduped, and dev-memory remains non-authoritative/non-gate evidence.

items.title: Verify no stashed dev-memory data file was restored
items.context: Acceptance requires git status to show no .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl restored, staged, or tracked from the stash, while the pinned stash object remains intact.
